projects.name: anomalyco/opencode
projects.type: 开源 AI 编码 Agent
projects.usage: curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash，或 brew / npm / scoop 安装后在项目目录运行 opencode
highlights: 开源版 Claude Code 类工具，可接多家模型
安装渠道极全（brew、scoop、pacman、nix、mise）
提供桌面版（Beta），21 种语言 README
cautions: 需要自备模型 API Key 或订阅
安装前先卸载 0.1.x 以下旧版本

en.usage: `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash`, or install via brew / npm / scoop, then run `opencode` in your project
highlights: An open-source Claude Code–style tool that works with many model providers
Available from almost every package manager (brew, scoop, pacman, nix, mise)
Desktop app (beta) and a README in 21 languages
cautions: Bring your own model API key or subscription
Remove versions older than 0.1.x before installing

projects.name: debpalash/VoiceStudio
projects.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
projects.stack: Electron + Python 后端（PyTorch）+ Rust，默认引擎 k2-fsa/OmniVoice
projects.type: 桌面应用 · AI 语音
projects.usage: 一行命令安装（curl voicestudio.sh/install | sh，Windows 用 irm|iex），或下载 dmg/exe/AppImage；也可让编码 Agent 按 docs/install/agent.md 自动装
highlights: 完全本地的 ElevenLabs 替代：克隆声音、设计声音、视频配音、听写、有声书
支持 646 种语言，CUDA / Apple Silicon 加速，无独显也能跑
自带本地 API 与 MCP，可被 Agent 调用
cautions: AGPL-3.0，商用二次分发要开源
声音克隆需取得本人授权，注意合规
CPU 版也要约 5GB 磁盘；Intel Mac 只能连远程后端

en.stack: Electron + Python backend (PyTorch) + Rust; default engine k2-fsa/OmniVoice
en.usage: One-line install (`curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh`, or `irm | iex` on Windows), or download the dmg/exe/AppImage; a coding agent can also install it via docs/install/agent.md
highlights: Fully local ElevenLabs alternative: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, audiobooks
646 languages; CUDA / Apple Silicon acceleration, still usable without a GPU
Built-in local API and MCP so agents can call it
cautions: AGPL-3.0: redistributing it commercially means open-sourcing your changes
Only clone voices with the speaker's consent
Even the CPU build needs ~5 GB of disk; Intel Macs can only connect to a remote backend

projects.name: stablyai/orca
projects.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Codex). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
projects.stack: TypeScript · 桌面 IDE（VS Code 编辑器内核 + WebGL 终端）
projects.usage: 官网下载桌面应用，另有 iOS / Android 伴侣 App；也可用 orca CLI 脚本化
highlights: 并排跑 Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode 等，每个 Agent 独立 git worktree，择优合并
手机端监控 Agent、接收完成通知
Design Mode：点选网页元素直接把 HTML/CSS/截图送进提示词
cautions: 多 Agent 并行会成倍消耗额度
迭代极快（每日发版），功能文档常滞后于 changelog

en.stack: TypeScript · desktop IDE (VS Code editor core + WebGL terminals)
en.usage: Download the desktop app from the website; iOS / Android companion apps; script it with the `orca` CLI
highlights: Run Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode side by side, each in its own git worktree, then merge the best result
Monitor agents and get finish notifications on your phone
Design Mode: click any page element to send its HTML/CSS and a screenshot into the prompt
cautions: Running agents in parallel multiplies your usage
Ships daily, so the docs often lag behind the changelog

projects.name: anthropics/claude-code
projects.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
projects.stack: TypeScript / Node 18+（仓库主要是插件与 issue）
projects.type: 官方 AI 编码终端工具
projects.usage: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash 或 brew install --cask claude-code，进入项目目录运行 claude
highlights: Anthropic 官方，终端内理解代码库、执行任务、处理 git
仓库附带多个官方插件示例
安装一行搞定，跨 macOS / Linux / Windows
cautions: 无开源许可证，仓库不是完整源码
需要 Claude 订阅或 API 额度
npm 安装方式已弃用

en.stack: TypeScript / Node 18+ (the repo is mostly plugins and issues)
en.usage: `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash` or `brew install --cask claude-code`, then run `claude` in your project
highlights: Anthropic's official tool: understands your codebase, runs tasks, handles git from the terminal
Repo ships several official example plugins
One-line install on macOS / Linux / Windows
cautions: No open-source license; the repo is not the full source
Needs a Claude subscription or API credits
The npm install method is deprecated

projects.name: affaan-m/ECC
projects.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
projects.stack: JavaScript / Node 18+，Claude Code 插件 + npm 包
projects.usage: Claude Code 内用插件命令安装 ecc@ecc，或 npm 包 ecc-universal 走引导式安装
highlights: 71 个 Agent、311 个 Skill、Hooks、记忆与持续学习一次装好
内置 AgentShield 扫描提示词、Hooks、MCP 配置与密钥
支持 Claude Code、Codex、Kimi 等 7 种 Agent 环境
cautions: 体量巨大，全部启用会占用上下文，建议按需挑选
有付费 Pro 版（私有仓库 $19/席/月）
README 提醒存在冒名包，只从官方渠道安装

en.stack: JavaScript / Node 18+, Claude Code plugin + npm package
en.usage: Install the `ecc@ecc` plugin inside Claude Code, or use the `ecc-universal` npm package's guided setup
highlights: 71 agents, 311 skills, hooks, memory and continuous learning in one install
AgentShield scans prompts, hooks, MCP config and secrets
Works with 7 harnesses including Claude Code, Codex and Kimi
cautions: Very large; enabling everything eats context, so pick what you need
Has a paid Pro tier ($19/seat/month for private repos)
README warns about impostor packages; install only from official channels

projects.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
projects.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
projects.stack: Python 3.10+ · Bun 招聘爬取 CLI · LaTeX 简历模板 · Claude Code 斜杠命令
projects.usage: 克隆后运行 tools/install_portal_clis.py，在 Claude Code 里依次用 /setup、/scrape、/apply、/interview
highlights: 作者亲测：69 份定制申请、20 次面试、拿到 offer
岗位匹配打分 + 定制简历/求职信 + 审稿 Agent 互评
流程与国家、语言无关，可扩展招聘门户
cautions: Fork 永远公开，个人资料会进仓库，应改用私有仓库
需要付费 Claude；还要装 LaTeX（lualatex/xelatex）
与 Anthropic 无关，项目方声明无任何代币

en.stack: Python 3.10+ · Bun job-board CLIs · LaTeX CV templates · Claude Code slash commands
en.usage: Clone, run `tools/install_portal_clis.py`, then use `/setup`, `/scrape`, `/apply`, `/interview` in Claude Code
highlights: Battle-tested by the author: 69 tailored applications, 20 interviews, one job offer
Fit scoring + tailored CV and cover letter + a reviewer agent that critiques drafts
Country- and language-agnostic; you can add your own job portals
cautions: Forks are always public and your profile lands in tracked files, so use a private repo
Needs paid Claude plus a LaTeX install (lualatex/xelatex)
Not affiliated with Anthropic; the project has no token

projects.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
projects.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
projects.stack: Python · Agent Skills 开放标准（SKILL.md + 辅助脚本）
projects.usage: 按 Agent Skills 标准安装到 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等，向 Agent 提科研任务即可自动调用
highlights: 177 个科研技能：生信、化学、医学、物理、地学等
覆盖 80 个科学数据库与 70+ Python 科研包的版本化流程
配套 arXiv 论文与视频教程
cautions: 仅限科研用途，明确不用于临床诊断
部分数据库需注册或授权
技能多，按领域挑选安装更省上下文

en.stack: Python · open Agent Skills standard (SKILL.md + helper scripts)
en.usage: Install per the Agent Skills standard into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.; the agent picks skills up automatically for research tasks
highlights: 177 research skills across biology, chemistry, medicine, physics, earth science and more
Versioned workflows for 80 scientific databases and 70+ Python packages
Backed by an arXiv paper and video tutorials
cautions: Research use only, explicitly not for clinical diagnosis
Some databases require registration or a license
Install by domain to save context

projects.name: xerj-org/xerj
projects.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep and sed. One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. Elasticsearch compatible, so existing clients just work.
projects.stack: Rust 单二进制 · MCP + Skill 接入
projects.type: 本地代码搜索引擎（给 Agent 用）
projects.usage: curl -fsSL https://xerj.org/get | sh，xerj init 接入 Claude Code/Cursor，xerj autoindex 建索引
highlights: 自动索引任意目录，Agent 直接取段落而非整文件读取
参考编码：先克隆相近开源仓库再检索解法
官方对照实验：输出 token 降 2.7 倍，解题率不变
cautions: --insecure 会关闭 TLS 与鉴权，只能本机单人使用
项目仅 3 个半月，watcher 只有 20，增速数据宜谨慎看待
社区要求用户提交 PR 形式的使用报告

en.stack: Rust single binary · MCP + skill integration
en.type: Local code search engine for agents
en.usage: `curl -fsSL https://xerj.org/get | sh`, `xerj init` to wire into Claude Code/Cursor, `xerj autoindex` to index
highlights: Auto-indexes any folder so agents fetch passages instead of reading whole files
Reference coding: clones similar open-source repos and searches how they solved it
Their controlled study: 2.7x fewer output tokens at the same solve rate
cautions: `--insecure` disables TLS and auth; single-user local only
Only 3.5 months old with 20 watchers; treat the growth numbers with care
The community asks users to file a field-report PR

projects.name: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
projects.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
projects.stack: Python · CLI-Hub 包管理（pip）· SKILL.md 生成
projects.type: 软件 → Agent CLI 转换框架
projects.usage: pip install cli-anything-hub，然后 cli-hub install <工具名>；或用 /cli-anything 命令为新软件生成 CLI
highlights: 把 GIMP、Blender、FreeCAD、Zotero 等桌面软件包装成 Agent 可用的 CLI
社区注册表持续收录新 CLI，每个都附 SKILL.md
港大 HKUDS 团队出品
cautions: 生成的 CLI 质量参差，需看测试覆盖
目标软件本体仍需自行安装
最近一次提交约 3 周前，节奏比前期放缓

en.stack: Python · CLI-Hub package manager (pip) · SKILL.md generation
en.usage: `pip install cli-anything-hub`, then `cli-hub install <tool>`; or generate a CLI for new software with `/cli-anything`
highlights: Wraps desktop software like GIMP, Blender, FreeCAD and Zotero as agent-ready CLIs
Community registry keeps adding CLIs, each with a SKILL.md
From the HKU Data Intelligence Lab (HKUDS)
cautions: Generated CLIs vary in quality; check their tests
You still need the target software installed
Last commit was ~3 weeks ago; pace has slowed

projects.name: ruvnet/ruflo
projects.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
projects.stack: TypeScript · MCP 服务器（314 个工具）· Claude Code 插件
projects.type: 多 Agent 蜂群编排框架
projects.usage: Claude Code 内 /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo 后安装 core/console/mods；其他客户端用 npx ruflo@latest init wizard
highlights: 前身 Claude Flow，提供 Agent 蜂群、跨会话记忆与联邦
可视化控制台：成本、蜂群、任务全程可查
有 14 章中文/英文入门指南
cautions: mods 以你的账户权限运行、未沙盒化，安装前读代码
概念宣传多，学习曲线陡
需要 Claude Code 2.1.287 以上

en.stack: TypeScript · MCP server (314 tools) · Claude Code plugins
en.usage: In Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo`, then install core/console/mods; other clients: `npx ruflo@latest init wizard`
highlights: Formerly Claude Flow: agent swarms, cross-session memory and federation
Visual console for cost, swarms and missions
14-chapter guide in English and Chinese
cautions: Mods run with your account's permissions and are not sandboxed; read the code first
Lots of conceptual marketing; steep learning curve
Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later

projects.name: android/skills
projects.type: 官方 Android 开发 Agent 技能
projects.usage: android skills add --all，或在 Claude Code 中 /plugin install android-skills --marketplace android/skills
highlights: Google 官方出品，只覆盖 LLM 评测中表现差的 Android 场景
一条命令装到所有已检测到的 Agent
支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 插件市场
cautions: 仅对 Android 开发者有用
不接受外部贡献

en.usage: `android skills add --all`, or in Claude Code `/plugin install android-skills --marketplace android/skills`
highlights: Official from Google, focused on Android tasks where LLMs score poorly in evals
One command installs into every detected agent
Available in the Claude Code, Codex and Gemini plugin marketplaces
cautions: Only useful for Android developers
No outside contributions accepted

projects.name: akitaonrails/ai-memory
projects.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
projects.stack: Rust 服务端 · git 版本化 Markdown wiki · 生命周期 Hooks
projects.usage: 自建 ai-memory 服务（本机或家庭服务器），用 ai-memory run <agent> 启动 Agent 即可交接
highlights: Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20+ Agent 共用一份记忆，中途换工具不丢上下文
记忆是纯 Markdown，可 grep、可用 Obsidian 打开
默认零 LLM 调用，记忆按使用频率自动衰减
cautions: 需要自己运维一个服务端
团队共享时注意哪些内容进了共享记忆

en.stack: Rust server · git-versioned Markdown wiki · lifecycle hooks
en.usage: Self-host the ai-memory server (laptop or homelab), then launch agents with `ai-memory run <agent>` to hand off
highlights: 20+ agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…) share one memory; switch tools mid-task without losing context
Memory is plain Markdown you can grep or open in Obsidian
Zero LLM calls by default; memory decays by usage
cautions: You have to run and maintain a server
On a team, watch what ends up in shared memory
